name: pdfmux
summary: Self-healing PDF extraction for RAG — #2 of 8 engines on opendataloader-bench (0.903). Flags pages it can't read instead of dropping them, and certifies any extractor's output for silent drops. Verify signed manifests offline, free. Per-page confidence, 7-tool MCP server, LangChain/LlamaIndex loaders. LlamaParse alternative.
author: Nameet Potnis
